note.text: Ask executives to name the AI they actually profit from and almost none of them say autonomous superintelligence. It is the narrow tool that reads contracts, routes trucks, or flags fraud, bounded enough to audit and dumb enough to trust. Yet board decks keep budgeting like the moonshot is the product and the boring tool is the side quest. Flip the ratio: fund the unglamorous 95% that works today, and let the 5% stay a research bet, not a roadmap.
